body.name: Calendar-varying finite-memory RIPW class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M(T,p,\mathcal S,\epsilon)\) is the set of tuples \((P,\Pi,\mu,m,\tau)\) such that \(\mathcal S\subseteq\{0,1\}^{T}\) is finite and nonempty, \(\Pi\in\Delta(\mathcal S)\), and the six conditions \(\Pi_s\geq\epsilon\), \(\pi_s(X)\geq c_{\pi}\), \(Y_t=Y_t(W)\), \(\mathbb E_P[Y_t(s)\mid W=s,X]=\mu_t(s,X)\), \(\mu_t(s,X)=m_t(X)+\sum_{\ell=0}^{p}\tau_{t,\ell}(X)(D_s)_{t,\ell}\), and \(G(\Pi)\succ0\) hold on the domains stated in Assumptions \(\mathrm{ass{:}reshaping\text{-}floor}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}path\text{-}overlap}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}consistency}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}path\text{-}mean\text{-}random\text{-}assignment}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}calendar\text{-}memory\text{-}mean}\), and \(\mathrm{ass{:}residual\text{-}full\text{-}rank}\), respectively.  No absorption restriction is imposed in this definition.
